text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu brilliantly conquered an 
Arima Kinen filled with titans. Undeterred 
by numerous disadvantages, she stayed true 
to her own run, leaving the crowd in utter 
awe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the roar of unending cheers, she 
whispered something toward her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The true meaning behind those words she 
couldn't catch. However... if it's her 
Trainer, the day will surely come when she 
understands.
